feedTitle: Weather forecast for the Isle of Man

items.title: Weather forecast updated as of 22 May 2026 8:20am
items.description:
##Weather##

Issued on Friday, 22 May 2026 at 8:20am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Detailed forecast##

Generally dry, with some low cloud and mist patches developing in southern and central areas. Otherwise, many places will be bright with some sunny spells. Moderate to fresh south or southwest winds will ease later, with temperatures reaching around 17°C in the north. Later this evening some occasional light rain may develop for a time.


##Outlook##

A largely fine and dry weekend, with decent spells of sunshine and temperatures in the high teens. However, mist may affect some coasts at times.
